title: O Pistoleiro
description: The film tells the story of three hired killers: one of them is a veteran of the profession; the other is naive, almost mentally weak; and the third is a circumstantial murderer who commits murder for revenge and is forced by a principal to take the path of crime.

title: O Taxista
description: O Taxista

title: O Taareee
description: Group of friends, who, for love, friendship and wooing the most beautiful girl in the college, tumble into a politically driven plot where a sudden murder brings them face to face with each other and a reality that shakes them to their core.

title: O Vyssinokipos, O Miki Maous & o Nikos Karathanos
Masha e o Urso: O Filme
description: Masha and the Bear: to the cinema. Young girl Masha, who can't sit still and the Bear who likes everything relaxed and in an orderly manner, have many new adventures together. Nice for young children as the adventures themselves take about 7 minutes each.

title: O anomalos
description: Police use a beautiful woman as bait for a maniacal killer of women, whose impotence was caused by a depraved female SS officer.

title: O Babão
description: Zé Babão is a hillbilly who does not care about working, leads the good life of the interior and is in love with Conchita. One day, an Italian appears interested in all the banana trees of Zé Babão and, for this, decides to marry Conchita.

title: Raul: O Início, o Fim e o Meio
description: The film tells the story of Raul Seixas, a Brazilian rock legend. The documentary unveils by rare archival images, meeting with family, conversations with artists, producers and friends, the trajectory of the artist, who died in 1989.

title: O pio kalos o mathitis
description: A businessman who balances between legality and illegality can't persuade his rightful employee to overlook his financial discrepancies. To succeed, he enlists the help of a beautiful woman; however, what happens if she, too, fails?

title: O xenagos
description: Iasonas arrives in Athens starting his new ambitious career as "architects' guide". His group consists of international students of Architecture, finishing their ERASMUS in Thessaloniki. Soon Iasonas faces the contradicting wishes of the students who prefer a day-long coffee or a visit to a graveyard than a guide to the Acropolis. Meanwhile, he meets back with his once (more than just a) best friend Mirsini. Trapped between a friend who progressively sees him less and less as a friend and a group that sees him less and less as a guide, Iasonas will have to give an answer to his own personal questions regarding his sexuality, his career and his life in general.

title: O Espigão
description: Lauro Fontana wants to build the biggest hotel in Brazil, but he needs to convince the Camará brothers to sell the mansion they live in, facing ethical dilemmas and personal obstacles.

title: O Cangaceiro
description: This is a remake of Brazil's first international success in the cinema world. Just as its same name predecessor was, this film is a fictional version of the story of the "cangaceiros." These were bandits who sacked towns and spread terror throughout Northeastern Brazil in the 1930s. This group of outlaws is led by Captain Galdino (played by Paulo Orgulho) and his wife Maria Bonita (Luiza Tome).

title: Despertar: O Mundo o Espera
description: Há seis anos, o presidente da Associação Mundial de Neurologia recusou convites de instituições médicas de elite para se dedicar a uma única missão, garantir a recuperação de uma pessoa extraordinária. Durante esse período, essa figura permaneceu em um quarto de luxo, com sua condição envolta em mistério. Não se tratava de um paciente comum – seis anos atrás, essa pessoa havia mudado o curso da história. Agora, com o despertar iminente, o mundo está prestes a testemunhar o retorno de uma lenda, cujas ações prometem transformar a realidade e trazer mudanças sísmicas.

title: The Case Notes of TAKAGI, P.I.
description: TAKAGI, a private investigator, is hired by a mysterious Japanese industrialist to undertake a deep topographic exploration of LA and beyond.

title: Ch. P. rayonnogo masshtaba
description: USSR society in the late Brezhnev years had its own yuppies: the 30 something Young Communist League officers rising in the Party bureaucracy.One is about to lose his rank after a theft from his office.

title: P@St Forward
description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

title: The Second Life of Jamie P
description: The year in the life story of Jamie Peebles, who transitions in real time. We filmed her confirmation surgery. She shares her suffering and her joys in personal and revelatory video diaries, inter-cut with Roger's cinema verite filming.

title: To agori p' agapo
description: Bent on conquering his heart, a crafty high-school student barges into the life of a debonair and handsome young actor. However, it will take two long years before he notices his persistent and beautiful fan. Do dreams come true?

title: P're hanggang sa huli
description: Copper Guerrero (Andrew E.) is a police man who just arrests a group of cattle rustlers and teams up with Brando del Valle (Robin Padilla) who was insulted by their Major due to his stupidity. Brando and Cooper tries to stop some thugs leading to a car chase resulting the thug's car crashes into a gas station destroying it. Cooper was kidnapped along with Jessica (Charlene Gonzales) and her friends by a group of kidnappers led by their leader (Mat Ranillo III). Cooper was tortured by their leader. Brando arrives to rescue him who is helped by a kidnapper who defects and leads them to Jessica in the airport hangar where she is been held by the kidnappers. They defeat the kidnappers and rescues Jessica and her friends while Brando kills the leader who tries to escape on a plane. One of the defeated kidnappers still alive and badly injures Jing-Jing (Angelu De Leon) who notices this and jumps on Brando protecting from the gunshot and Brando throws his army knife at the still alive kidnapper and Cooper kills it. They mourn Jing-Jing as the Major and his police forces arrives who congratulate Brando but he respectfully rejected his promotion and orders a suspension from his position and he kindly accepts his offer and Brando hands him his badge. The defected kidnapper leaves on a motorcycle turning out that he was also a police officer who was sent by the Major to help him on the mission. Some time later Brando and Cooper had a romance with Jessica and her friend in the train.

title: Patrolman P
description: In 1971 the Knapp Commission, entrusted to expose corruption in the New York Police Department, faces a major problem. They have little physical evidence - their main source, Frank Serpico, won't wear a wire. They finally strike gold when a corrupt cop named William Phillips agrees to become their undercover agent, in exchange for immunity from a bribery charge. The evidence he eventually collects leads directly to the indictment of thirty New York cops. But the tables quickly turn when Phillips himself is convicted of a double-homicide. Three decades later and still in prison Phillips claims he's the victim of a massive police conspiracy.

title: Il secondo principio di Hans Liebschner
Black story (La historia negra de Peter P. Peter)
description: Pedro is a successful novelist who writes crime novels under the pseudonym Peter P. Peter. After being widowed, he marries Beatriz, who is also a recent widow. His new married life turns out to be hell, since his wife makes life impossible for him and he has fallen madly in love with his secretary Carlota. The experience that his novels have given him leads him to hatch a plan to poison his new wife, but she also plans to kill him in order to marry Jerónimo.

title: Vice ibinahagi ang pangarap para sa relasyon nila ni Ion
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa Miss Q&A
description:
What doesn't kill you makes you stronger, at sa bawat pagsubok ay mas tumatatag ang character. Mula sa Bahay ni Kuya, balik-“Showtime” na si Cianne Dominguez, hawak muli ang mikropono, slay kung slay sa pagpe-perform sa entablado. Group hug para kay Cianne!

Kung ang mood mo ay hindi kagandahan, mga beki ay may hatid kaming bonggang katatawanan. Sa talas ng isip at husay sa talakan, ang Miss Q&A candidates na ang bahalang magpagaan ng 'yong pakiramdam.

Sina Magdalena Fox, Maria Divina Bulawan Gil, at Yems Deligario Espinola, nagpalitan ng mga hirit. Si Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa kanyang pagpapakatotoo at transformation, at sa aktingan niya with Vhong Navarro.

Huwag hayaang malunod sa kalungkutan, sumabay sa alon ng saya at tawanan. Mula sa Dagat-Dagatan, Navotas, ang Madlang Players ay nakipagsapalaran, at baka sa Laro Laro Pick ay makabingwit pa ng malaking papremyo at kasiyahan.

Sa Act-Song round, ang script nila ni Darren Espanto, hindi kinaya ni Jackie Gonzaga sa kanilang aktingan. From one role to another, si Darren 'social distancing' pa rin ang gusto. Ayaw "madamay" kay hindi na lang daw muna siya magmo-move closer kay Cianne.

Sa jackpot round, si Aichelle ang sumabak sa larong may halong kaba. Ang Li-Pot offer na P25,000, tinanggap niya para siguradong may maihahanda sa darating na Pasko para sa pamilya. May panghihinayang nga lang na naramdaman si Aichelle dahil alam pala niya ang sagot sa P150,000 na POT question.

title: Miss Q&A Rexy, UMIYAK nang matalo
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: ANG LAYO! Anne, napanganga sa sagot ni Miss Q&A Jemzian
description:
Fun ang naging kuwentuhan. Bringing flavor to the hosts' table ang magandang kombinasyon ng mga hosts mula sa magkaibang henerasyon. Dalawang OGs, Vice Ganda at Anne Curtis, kasama ang dalawang Gen Zs, Darren Espanto at Brent Manalo, naghatid ng good vibes ang chikahan.

Sa queendom na ’to, bawat kandidata’y handang lumaban baon ang wit at confidence para ang trono’y makamtan. Pero sa Miss Q and A weekly finals, iisa lang ang pwedeng koronahan. Nakipag-agawan sa titulo sina Bebe, Ringo Antonio, Edz Amats, Jemzian Licuanan Seco, Maria Princess Joy Rosario, at Hera Sanchez Santivañez.

Apat na kandidata ang umabante sa Wit Lang Round, kung saan mas lalo pang nasubok ang bilis ng kanilang isip sa mga tanong na kanilang nabunot. Ito ay sina Hera, Edz, Maria Princess, at Jemzian.

Mula sa apat, sina Maria Princess at Jemzian ang nag-face off sa Beklamation sa tanong na, “Sasama ba ang loob mo sa mga magulang mo kung hindi ka nabigyan ng magandang buhay?” Pareho silang nanindigang hindi sasama ang kanilang loob sa kanilang mga magulang.

Kapag may um-order, mabilis nilang sinasabing, “Ready na po!” Pero ngayong sila ang players, ready na rin kayang manalo? Sana hainan sila ng malaking papremyo. Mga service crew ang bida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagkatapos ng challenges, si Grace ang only survivor at nakakuha ng spot sa jackpot round kung saan P300,000 ang nag-aabang. Pero dahil mas okay na ‘yung sigurado, pagkatapos ng mahabang tawaran, nagpasya si Grace na maging praktikal at ‘lumi-POT’ na lang. Tama ba ang desisyon ni Grace o uuwi siyang may panghihinayang?

title: Miss Q&A: Ano ang English ng tanikala?
description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.

title: Hosts Miss Q&A candidates nag reveal ng LOVE STATUS
description:
Anuman ang status ng 'yong puso, saktong-sakto ang happiness at good vibes na hatid ng "Showtime Online U" squad na nagse-celebrate ng 10th anniversary.

PaLOVEan sa rampahan at talakan sina Miss Q and A candidates Callout Everdean, Adam Lambert, at Cali Serion.

Feeling reyna agad si Callout dahil sa winner niyang love life. Ipinakilala ng kandidata ang kanyang American husband. Ibang mukha ng pag-ibig naman ang ipinakita ni Adam, na focused muna sa career dahil na-trauma sa past relationship. Si Cali naman na isang iskolar ng bayan, pag-ibig ng ina ang inaasam.

Dahil napag-uusapan na ang pag-ibig, naisip ni Vice na alamin ang love status ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Na-intriga ang Madlang People sa mga status nina Kim Chiu, Darren Espanto, at Jackie Gonzaga. Pero ang status na pinakatumagos sa puso ng hosts at Madlang People, 'yung sinabi ni Ryan Bang, "Nadurog parang paminta. Pero may bubuo. Sino kaya?"

Agad nakapasok ang University of the Philippines student na si Cali sa Wit Lang round, kung saan ibinuhos niya ang puso sa tanong na, "Ano ang gagawin mo kung sa sobrang bait mo handa ka nang kunin ni Lord?" In-enjoy naman ni Adam ang talak sa tanong na, "Ano ang nararamdaman ng valid ID na laging dalawa silang hinahanap?"

Dahil sumilip na ang Haring Araw, extra sunny at bubbly ang mood ng mga taga-Malinta, Valenzuela na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Angel, isang masipag na nanay. Sa kanilang usapan, napa-isip si Vice Ganda sa pagkakaiba ng bawat henerasyon. Kaya nga ba minsan 'magulo' ang mundo dahil sa pagsasama-sama ng iba't ibang henerasyon?

Samantala, nakaka-Gen Z ang kilig na hatid nina Darren at Jackie sa isang eksena. Aba, si Darren, nagpapalambing na! Panindigan n'yo kilig namin!

Sumikat ang swerte kay JM matapos niyang malampasan ang lahat ng challenges. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer at sinubukan pa ni Kim na kumbinsihin si JM na tanggapin ito. Pero hindi nagpatinag si JM at sinugalan ang POT question. Magtagumpay kaya si JM at maiuwi ang P300,000 POT money?

title: MC at Lassy nilaro ang INTRO ng mga Miss Q&A
description:
Sabi nila, may darating na someone, someday, 'yung kapag nakita mo siya parang laging may background music ang paligid. Kapit lang, dahil minsan dumarating 'yan nang biglaan. Habang hinihintay ang pagdating ng pag-ibig, heto na si Mr. Randomantic James Reid, handang magpakilig!

Lahat sa mundo may halaga, mula sa mga kulisap hanggang bulaklak sa hardin at mga puno (please huwag naman natin silang putulin). Sa Miss Q and A, boses ng mga kandidata ay may halaga at aral na puwedeng pulutin.

Huwag 'inaancha' ang mga kandidata dahil hindi sila basta-basta. May maipagmamalaking talento, talino at puso sina Summer Rejane Corpuz, Wilson The Buss, at Jomaima Johnson na nagpagalingan sa talakan.

Hot na hot talaga ang puksaan with special guest hurado Marina Summers. Present pa rin si Nicole Cordoves, with Ralph de Leon. Sina Wilson The Buss at Jomaima ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Parehobg bumoses, pero sa korona, isa lang ang sumakses! Si Jomaima ang wagi bilang Miss Q&A Reyna Talakers of the day.

Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Tonsuya, Malabon sa game arena.

Pagdating ng You Gotta Lyric round, si Dalag ang only player na naka-survive! Baka pampaalis ng kaba, nakipa-playtime si Dalag sa mga trip ni Vice Ganda hanggang sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000 ay kanyang tinanggap.

title: Pokwang havey ang comment sa Miss Q&A It's Showtime October 27 2026
description:
Maningning ang pagsisimula ng Tuesday sa “It’s Showtime.” We choose happiness, and we choose a fun jamming with Jan Roberts at Lola Amour with their song "Tapos Na Ba Tayong Dalawa."

Times four ang tawanan dahil sanib-pwersa muli ang quadro nina Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro sa paboritong "It's Showtime" segment na Miss Q and A.

Times three naman ang wit at good vibes na dala nina candidates Labinya Winter, Valerie Evangelistar, at Gibi Esguerra who made the FUNanghalian extra interesting dahil sa mga talak nila na 'it's giving.'

Habang kinikilala ang mga kandidata, nalaman ni Vice Ganda angbpagkahilig ni Gibi sa luxury items, kaya hate niya si ‘judith.’ Payo naman ni Meme Vice, mag-impok lalo na sa kalusugan dahil walang tao na hindi nagkakasakit. Health is wealth, ‘ika nga.

Sa Wit Lang, sina Labinya at Gibi ang nag-face off. Dahil sa LOVE-an na LOVE-an niyang kasagutan, with lots of love na tinanggap ni Gibi ang korona as today's Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Make sure you are always smiling para dumapo ang blessing. POT question ay dapat masagot nang tama para ang premyong inaasam ay ma-achieve sa Laro Laro Pick. Tourism students ng NCR ang bumida sa game arena.

Si Maica, kabado for today’s video. Pero nawala ang kaba nang tabihan ni jowa. Madlang People ay kinilig kina Maica at Cris at sa kanilang kuwentong pag-ibig.

At ang harana ni player Ainsley, nauwi sa busking. Ang galing! Para bang may swerteng dala ang boses niya, dahil si Ainsley ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round. Tama ba ang napili niya?

title: Sassa Gurl napadaan sa Miss Q and A
description:
Tayo'y always napapalingon sa kanyang mapulang blush, ang awrahan ni Sasa Gurl for today's video, deserve ng sash. Best in Costume 'yan? Ang Halloween, parang dumating in advance.

Humagupit na sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang bumabagyong kagandahan at wit ng mga kandidata sa "Miss Q and A."

Kung costume party ito, effortless si Miss Q&A Kulot ng Cavite, ang 'bunot' ni Vice Ganda for today. Pinag-sample ng gymnastics at pinakanta, pero ang hindi niya naipakita ay 'yung talent na kumagat ng bakal. Isa pang talent niya ay pasayahin ang Madlang People sa charisma niyang kamahal-mahal.

Umuwi man siyang 'lotlot' sa kompetisyon, nasungkit naman niya ang puso ng buong nation. Samantala, sina Chloe Castillo ng Isabela at Rhed Sicuan ng Las Pinas ang umabante sa Wit Lang round kung saan tuluyan nilang pinakawalan ang fierce na skill sa talakan.

Para kina hurado Max Collins, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves, mas matimbang ang bilang ng sagot ni Rhed. Siya ang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Susuyuin ng mga taga-Manuyo Dos, Las Pinas ang swerte upang masungkit nila ang Laro Laro Pick POT money sa “It’s Showtime” July 9 episode.

Enjoy ang hosts sa chikahan with Tin, na pangarap maging pulis noong kabataan pero ngayon makeup na ang kanyang fantasy. Kakaiba naman ang nickname ni Meow, ang solo parent na raketera queen.

Samantala, now showing ang Episode 4 ng Memerimar sa act-song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round. Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro) nagselos dahil para bang mas mahal ni Memerimar (Vice Ganda) si Fulgoso (Lassy). Dumating naman sina Senyora Angelika (Jhong Hilario) at Inocencia (MC) upang makipagsundo kay Memerimar. Pero ang batian, nauwi sa bugbugan!

Sa jackpot round, mabilisan ang naging tawaran nang tanggapin agad ni Lenlen ang Li-Pot offer na P30,000. Malaking tulong na kasi ito pra sa therapy ng anak niyang nasa autism spectrum.

title: Miss Q&A Queen, naghandog ng tula para sa ina
description:
Malakas man ang ulan, hindi naman suspended ang pagbibigay ng good vibes ng "It's Showtime" family. Present pa si Anne Curtis kaya mas may bitaw ang happiness. Umulan din ng kilig sa studio dahil sa pagbisita nina Kapamilya stars Alexa Ilacad at BGYO Gelo Rivera, na tuloy-tuloy ang pagpapakilig sa series nilang "The Chambermaid's Daughter."

Pumasok sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang Signal No. 4 na lakas ng dating nina Queen Kaycee Isorena, Bong Bong, at Rocky Cueva.

Inspirasyon ang hatid ng tatlong kandidata sa mga kuwento nila. Si Queen Kaycee, ipinagmalaki ang pagmamahal ng ina, ang number one cheerleader niya as a kontesera. Marami rin ang napangiti sa modern family ni Bong Bong, na very proud to introduce his girlfriend Jillian at ang binata niyang anak. Ang baon naman ni Rocky, kuwento kung paano nabuo ang love story nila ng boyfriend na afam.

Pagkatapos ng kuwentuhan, naging masaya rin ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round hanggang sa nakapasok sina Rocky at Bong Bong sa Wit Lang.

Tuloy-tuloy ang talak, ayaw paawat ni Rocky sa pagsagot sa tanong na, "Payag ka lagi kang may kayakap sa gabi pero lumilipad siya sa madaling araw?" Nabunot naman ni Bong Bong ang tanong na, "Payag ka may kapangyarihan kang magbuga ng hangin pero hanggang number one lang?"

Maulan man sa labas, it was still a great day para sa taga-Barangay Greater Lagro, Quezon City na sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, para i-test ang swerte nila. Hindi naman mabe-break ang chemistry nina Anne Curtis at Vhong Navarro, na maraming pinakilig sa eksena nilang pinagsaluhan sa You Gotta Lyric round.

Mabilis ang mga pangyayari sa game arena, hanggang si Suzi na lang ang natira. Para kay Suzi, tapang ang 'suzi' sa tagumpay at sahil gustong ilaban ang pangarap ng apat niyang anak, sinugalan niya ang POT question. Mali man ang sagot ni Suzi, ang mahalaga paldo naman siya sa pagmamahal ng mga anak, at makakatanggap pa siya ng regalo mula kay Jhong Hilario.

Wearily, Zelzah decides to grab breakfast with him, which turns into a day-long exploration of the city of St. Louis - and their failed relationship. title: Street Fighter II: V S1-S2
description: Based off of the video game, on an island off the coast of Japan, Ryu, a martial artist, was given an invitation and some American money from his friend Ken Masters, telling him to come to the United States. Ryu arrives in San Francisco and Ken picks him up from the airport. Only to find out that Ken is rich and a defined martial artist himself. One night both Ryu and Ken were out scouting San Francisco for bars. Then, Ken flirts with somebody's girlfriend and gets into a fight. Ken has defeated the person. Only to find out that it was a partner of Air force pilot Guile. Ryu fights him, but was defeated easily. Ken then finds Guile and was too defeated. Ken then realizes that guile was a fighter of thew likes that Ryu and Ken has not seen before, Guile was a Street Fighter. So, both Ryu and Ken decided to set out to the world to learn the ways of the street fighter. Then, they get tangled up into a conspiracy involving a criminal organization.

title: Murder in Polná
description: An exciting drama from a detective history. In 1899 a dead girl - seamstress Anezka Hruzová - was found between the village of Veznicka and the town of Polná. She was 19 and she had a cutting wound on the throat. There was no sexual violence involved and since the local doctors thought that there was not enough blood on the crime scene, everyone jumped to the conclusion that Jews must have killed her and added her blood to their pass-over matzot. There was a potential murderer at hand too - a cheeky, not very bright young Jewish rover, Leopold Hilsner...

title: W Wish
description: Juuna Tono is a boy without a past. Orphaned by a tragic accident that claimed the lives of his parents and his memory, Juuna and his younger twin sister Senna have only survived by their commitment to support each other. But when a strange girl greets him as "Big Brother" (onii-chan) Juuna turns to her and says, "Haru...hi?" It is someone from his forgotten past, who Senna claims is his childhood friend - or is she?

title: My w Metropolii
description: News, documentary TV series examining what is a metropolis? Each show has unique guests from Gdansk like President Lech Walesa to actress Beata Pozniak Daniels.

title: Shamshoun & Dalila
description: In a blend of comedy, suspense, and action, Shamshon is forced to steal a legendary diamond to rescue his kidnapped sister, while Dalilah is mysteriously tasked with stealing it for herself. Their missions intersect in a chase filled with tricks, pranks, and clever confrontations, transforming their seemingly disparate paths into an unexpected love story. Ultimately, they are forced to join forces with an international alliance to determine who is the best and to seize the diamond at any cost.

title: Yakout W Anber
description: The series revolves around the family of Moulay Ahmed, one of the most famous merchants in Casablanca, a father of six daughters, who dreams of having a son who will inherit his wealth and lineage. Moulay Ahmed's wife, Anber, discovers that the gender of her fetus is a girl again.

title: W Series
description: W Series is an all-female single-seater motor racing championship. It was created in response to the lack of female drivers within the motorsport industry and thus limit the chances of progressing to the highest levels of motorsport, particularly Formula 1. The series' first season was in 2019; it featured twenty drivers contesting six races.

title: Bóg w Krakowie
description: Set today against the backdrop of a charming, mysterious and mystical city in which we follow the fate of its inhabitants: a young politician who receives a corrupt offer; girls looking for love and more.

title: A.W.O.L
description: Vietnam. 1972. US Army Special Forces Major Cliff Marquette leads a squad ordered to investigate unusual reports and secure a remote jungle temple locals believe has mystical powers. The Marines guarding the temple have withheld provisions for days from a Viet Cong prisoner. Despite severe mistreatment, the prisoner mysteriously shows no signs of suffering. Marquette confronts the Marine in charge, Garris for torturing a prisoner of war when suddenly enemy forces attack and mortar shells rock the temple. An exceptionally heroic, but losing battle lands Marquette in the hands of a merciless Viet Cong torturer. His men are dead; his screams unheeded. At the height of agony, Marquette's world is turned upside down. In an instant, he finds himself a stranger in the midst of an American life that apparently belongs to him - an idyllic but unrecognizable life complete with a loving wife and two children he's never seen before. Marquette struggles to take in what is happening to him. First is paranoia. Soon uncertainty and fear give way to relief and acceptance. But the twist of fate that delivered Marquette into this life from the hands of his enemy has granted him only a reprieve. The cruel pain of war is not over. As the clock strikes midnight Marquette is back in Vietnam where his torture resumes a few minutes each night. Desperately trapped between two worlds, Marquette must endure;unless, with the clock counting down, he can cheat fate. Escaping will take his wits;and it will require a gun.

title: masakra w
description:
Amerykański western w wersji z polskim lektorem - Masakra w Dragoon Wells.

Oficer kawalerii jako jedyny ocalał z ataku Indian. Wraz z wozem pełnym więźniów i skazańców, przemierza terytorium wrogo nastawionych Indian.

Masakra w Dragoon Wells (1957)
Reżyser: Harold D. Schuster
Scenarzyści: Warren Douglas, Oliver Drake
W rolach głównych: Barry Sullivan, Dennis O'Keefe, Mona Freeman
Gatunek: western
Kraj: USA
Język: angielski
Data premiery: 28 lutego 1958 r. (RFN)
Miejsca kręcenia: Kanab, Utah, USA

Fabuła:
Oficer kawalerii, jedyny ocalały z ataku Indian, wraz z wagonem więźniów przemierza wrogie tereny indiańskie.

Recenzje:
"„Nie jestem obiektywny, bo mam z tym filmem osobiste wspomnienia. Jako nastolatek lubiłem kolorowe westerny z popularnymi aktorami. Dziś wolę czarno-białe klasyki. Latem 1956 roku przypadkiem trafiłem na plan zdjęciowy tego filmu w Utah. Widziałem, jak kręcono kilka scen z O'Keefe’em i Cabotem. Później obejrzałem film w kinie i zaskoczyło mnie, że fabuła jest bardziej złożona niż w typowych westernach z lat 50. Nie ma tu jednego bohatera – to historia wielu postaci. Polecam każdemu, kto lubi filmy z dobrze napisanymi postaciami i solidną realizacją. Szkoda, że trudno znaleźć ten film na DVD.”
Autor: hitt_dave na IMDb.com
 

„To nie jest prosty western. Kapitan kawalerii i więźniowie muszą współpracować, by przetrwać na terenie Indian. Aktorstwo stoi na wysokim poziomie, reżyseria jest solidna, a muzyka buduje napięcie. Film ogląda się z prawdziwą przyjemnością.”
Autor: bux na IMDb.com

title: Y
description: A Balkan war veteran - who is now a homeless alcoholic - dreams that he is a tree growing inside the ruins of his house, which was destroyed in a bombing raid.

title: Y
description: 'Y' is a Marathi thriller explored through hyperlinked narrative. The film revolves around four parallel yet interwoven stories coinciding at times.

title: Y
description: Olga's carefree life and family dynamics slowly starts shifting after her grandmother, a very wealthy lawyer, makes an unexpected confession on her deathbed.

title: Y Syrcas
description: A unique film for all the family. Set in 1848, it tells the story of a young girl who is bewitched by the excitement of the travelling circus as it visits her small town in west Wales.

title: Y Swn
description: In 1979, when Margaret Thatcher's first government breaks a promise to establish a Welsh language television channel, a wave of civil disobedience follows. One man - Gwynfor Evans - threatens to starve himself to death unless the government comes good on its manifesto pledge. The reimagining of one of the most colourful chapters in contemporary Welsh history.

title: ¿Y los tamales?
description: A Honduran cabbie is entrusted with picking up a payload of tamales for Christmas Eve. On his journey, he picks up some spicy characters that all have their secrets to hide. Together, they take a long taxi ride into comical redemption.

title: Nina y Laura
description: An essay on grief.

title: Fuerte y afortunada

title: Rocío y José
description: José is a 17-year-old Andalusian boy who strikes up a relationship with a girl his age, Rocío, during the famous pilgrimage of the same name that takes place in the Huelva town of Almonte. In that place, accompanying the carts and horses, they strengthen their love as they walk the path that will take them to the hermitage where the Virgin is found.

title: Chasing Luck(Y)
description: A man who plays lottery for years suddenly wins 4 million euros, despite his previous lack of success. However, a winning ticket somehow finds its way to the hands of local pub's owners. After finding out that the police and two local crooks are after them, they escape to Greece, but their hosts mistakenly make announcement of the lottery winners over all mediums. From that point, everybody sets out on the way to Greece hoping to find the missing ticket.

title: Vagabundo y millonario
description: After failing to locate a kidnapped millionaire, the chief of police fools an identical-looking tourist to pose as the kidnapped gentleman to fool the criminals into letting him loose.

title: Lucho y Ramos
description: An absentminded burglar is caught in the act by the owner of the house he's stealing.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, an administrative detective, gets the unexpected obligation of the custody of his half-brother, Lorenzo Montero, who has an IQ of 200, and changes the way of life and work of the detective.

title: Oro y Polvo
description: The real-life story of a drug cartel leader set to Macbeth.

title: ¿Y ahora que?
description: 13-episode Documento-fiction series whose aim is to help boys and girls who are going through puberty to understand the physical, hormonal, social and emotional changes that take place at this stage of life.

title: Aquí y Allá
description: "AQUÍ": Pedro returns home to a small mountain village in Guerrero, Mexico after years of working in the US. He finds his daughters older, and more distant than he imagined. His wife still has the same smile. Having saved some earnings from two trips to the US, he hopes to now finally make a better life with his family, and even to pursue his dreams on the side by starting a band: Copa Kings. He cherishes the everyday moments with his family. "ALLÁ": The villagers think this year's crop will be bountiful. There is also good work in a growing city an hour away. But the locals are wise to a life of insecurity, and their thoughts are often of family members or opportunities far away, north of the border. While working in the fields, Pedro meets and begins to mentor a teenager who dreams of the US. That place somehow always feels very present, practically knocking at the door. "Aquí y Allá" is a story about hope, and the memories and loss of what we leave behind.

title: Terror y feria
description: Collection of small, independent stories, with the premise that all of them are terror/bizarre related.

title: Sueños y caramelos
description: Sofia's grandfather is the head security guard at a huge department store, "El Gran Almacen". At night, while her grandfather guards the store, Sofia uses her imagination to turn the department store into a world of fantasy and dreams. She decides to tell her friends about this new world, and she and her friends have many adventures there. She meets a new boy, Juan, whom she believes is a poor orphan--but in fact he's the son of Mauricio, the department store's owner, and his biggest fear is that he'll lose her friendship forever if and when she discovers his true identity.

title: Pablo y Carolina
description: Torn between three lovers and bored by her typewriting classes, Carolina (Dillian) writes a passionate love letter to fictional Pablo Garza from Monterrey. The letter is sent by mistake and received by real Pablo Garza's girlfriend. Pablo himself (Infante) flies to Mexico City looking for an explanation. Carolina is rehearsing a musical show for her school dressed as a man. When Pablo meets her, she pretends to be her brother Anibal, a shy and feminine sailor. Pablo likes Anibal and invites "him" to a cabaret. After that, Carolina falls inlove with Pablo but resists to unveil her real self. Meanwhile, Pablo feels himself confused, because young "Anibal" is cute as an angel and has "those blue eyes..."

title: Alegrijes y rebujos
description: A group of children discover the secret behind a haunted mansion.

title: The Y
description: The Y is a SciFi psychological thriller about a woman with a split soul searching to reconnect before she becomes TheY.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, a frustrated detective, receives a second chance when he is forced to adopt his 10 year old brother (who happens to be a child prodigy). With his help, Franco will solve the most complicated mysteries.

title: Lluvia y ceniza
description: Jaime is an unsuccessful painter who lives in his house, accompanied by Blanca, who suffers psychological abuse from him.

title: Las dos y media y... veneno
description: The old Don Senén has squandered in sprees the inheritance of his niece Begoña rather than manage it. There is still a million pesetas, which will only be delivered after the death of Don Senén. To get it, the old man, in complicity with Begoña and two other nephews (Ramón and Marcos) will fake his death. But Ramón and Marcos really planned to poison their uncle putting cyanide in his milk to keep them with money - When poor Quintín, Justo and Paloma (funeral parlor's workers) arise at Don Senén's home they will find an overview full of misunderstandings.

title: Z
description: A family finds themselves terrorized by their eight-year-old son's imaginary friend.

title: Z-Mom
description: A woman's family trip to a private island turns into a zombie outbreak. Her loved ones become infected, but she survives. Determined to save her family and others, she chooses to combat the zombie pandemic rather than join them.

title: Z-Listers
description: Three friends navigate the social hierarchy of LA with hopes of moving up the social ladder. Turns out, making it into the A-List is a bit harder than they thought.

title: Love Duo
description: Janhavi is in an intimate relationship for 4 years with her boyfriend Sameer. The story takes a turn when Sameer asks Janhavi to introduce him to her mother. Janhavi's mother has some cunning plans to fulfill her hidden fantasies after meeting Sameer.

title: My Lucky Star
description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

title: Still a Family
description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

title: Class 4 Hindi - All Chapters Rimjhim NCERT Book
description:
कक्षा 4 हिंदी प्लेलिस्ट में आपका स्वागत है! यह संकलित वीडियो कलेक्शन कक्षा 4 के छात्रों के हिंदी सीखने के मार्ग में मदद करने के लिए तैयार किया गया है। चाहे आप छात्र हों, शिक्षक हों या अपने बच्चे की सीखने को समर्थन करने वाले माता-पिता हों, यह प्लेलिस्ट आपकी मदद करने के लिए यहां है।

इस व्यापक प्लेलिस्ट में, आपको कक्षा 5 हिंदी पाठ्यक्रम के विभिन्न विषयों और अवधारणाओं को कवर करने वाले वीडियो देखने को मिलेंगे। प्रत्येक वीडियो को स्पष्ट और सरल तरीके से प्रस्तुत किया गया है, जिससे छात्र सामग्री को प्रभावी ढंग से समझ सकें।

प्लेलिस्ट पाठ्यक्रम के साथ मेल खाती है और मूलभूत अवधारणाओं से शुरू होकर धीरे-धीरे उन्नत विषयों की ओर बढ़ती है। वीडियो व्याकरण, शब्दावली, पठन समझ, लेखन कौशल और हिंदी साहित्य जैसे महत्वपूर्ण क्षेत्रों को कवर करते हैं |

title: Databases and SQL for Data Science with Python
description:
Working knowledge of SQL (or Structured Query Language) is a must for data professionals like Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Engineers. Much of the world's data resides in databases. SQL is a powerful language used for communicating with and extracting data from databases.
In this course you will learn SQL inside out- from the very basics of Select statements to
advanced concepts like JOINs. 
You will: 
-write foundational SQL statements like: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE 
-filter result sets, use WHERE, COUNT, DISTINCT, and LIMIT clauses 
-differentiate between DML & DDL 
-CREATE, ALTER, DROP and load tables 
-use string patterns and ranges; ORDER and GROUP result sets, and built-in database functions
-build sub-queries and query data from multiple tables 
-access databases as a data scientist using Jupyter notebooks with SQL and Python
-work with advanced concepts like Stored Procedures, Views, ACID Transactions, Inner & Outer JOINs through hands-on labs and projects
You will practice building SQL queries, work with real databases on the Cloud, and use real data science tools. 
In the final project you’ll analyze multiple real-world datasets to demonstrate your skills.
